# opnsense_quagga_ospf6_redistribution (Resource)

Manages one OPNsense OSPFv3 redistribution rule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description for this redistribution rule. Defaults to an empty string.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable this redistribution rule. Defaults to `true`.
- `redistribute` (String) Routing source redistributed into OSPFv3. Defaults to `connected`.
- `route_map` (String) UUID of the route map applied to redistributed routes. Defaults to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the redistribution rule.
